title: Seed Growth With Supplied Narration
tests: Tests whether a supplied script becomes verbatim audible narration synchronized with an explanatory visual sequence.

exact_text.text: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.
exact_text.read_as: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward.

faults.what: The voice-over omits the entire clause about the shoot reaching up toward the light.
The starting object looks like a large, glossy red flower bud rather than a recognizable seed, then changes into a leafy plant with an unusually bulky, exposed root crown.

The required growth sequence is not clearly explained: water reaching the seed is not shown in the supplied frames, and large leaves are already present at 3 seconds before the downward roots become clearly visible at 5 seconds.
The detailed, photorealistic glass-tank scene does not match the requested simple animation.

judge.summary: The 8-second widescreen clip shows a plant developing in a glass tank, but the narration is incomplete and the seed-to-sprout sequence is unclear.

must_haves.item: One approximately 8-second widescreen video shows an animated seed sprouting.
must_haves.why: The duration and widescreen format are correct, and the plant changes across frames, but the starting object resembles a red flower bud rather than a recognizable seed sprouting.

must_haves.item: The audible voice-over says the supplied script verbatim, without extra spoken lines.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcript ends at 'Roots grow downward.' and omits the remaining script.

must_haves.item: Water reaches the seed, roots grow downward, and a shoot grows upward toward light in that order.
must_haves.why: Water reaching the seed is not demonstrated in the frames, and leafy upward growth is visible before clear downward roots. A later shoot does extend toward the overhead light.

must_haves.item: The corresponding growth stages appear while the narration describes them.
must_haves.why: Water uptake is not clearly depicted, and the upward shoot stage has no corresponding narration because that clause is missing.

must_haves.item: There is no on-screen text or music.
must_haves.why: No on-screen text is visible, but the supplied sound information does not establish whether music is absent.
